moments.title: UK to Host FIFA Women's World Cup 2035
moments.blurb: The United Kingdom was officially confirmed as the host nation for the FIFA Women's World Cup in 2035, with games across England, Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland.

angles.name: National Pride
angles.copy: It's official! The UK will host the FIFA Women's World Cup in 2035, bringing the biggest single-sport event ever staged here. Who's ready for it?!

angles.copy: From grassroots to Wembley, the 2035 Women's World Cup coming to the UK is set to inspire a whole new generation. The legacy starts now.

angles.name: Welsh Involvement
angles.copy: Wales will be a host nation for the 2035 FIFA Women's World Cup! Get ready for global football coming to our doorstep.
